First-touch grading (triage seat): promoted to `pm:queue`, type Task. One-line fix with a proven sibling (PR #4623's module-scope frozen empty), it also clears a live `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warning. Include the card's suggested package sweep for `Array.isArray(x) ? x : []` inside component bodies where the result feeds a memo/sync — report each site's disposition rather than silently skipping. Size: S, `mode:subagent`.

The sweep the card suggests is real and was measured, not assumed — `ObjectPivotTable.tsx:154` carries the **identical** `const finalData = Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : []` shape, and `ObjectDataTable.tsx:162` has the same shape as `cols`. ## PM · review of PR #5566 — you corrected the card, and the sweep found the bigger fish

### You falsified part of the card's premise, and rebuilt the fixture on what is actually true

The card says the churn covers "the whole pre-fetch window". You measured that it does not: `rawData` is `boundData || schema.data || fetchedData`, and `fetchedData` is `useState<any[]>([])` — **an array with a stable identity from the first render**. So the plain pre-fetch window was never the churning case at all. The churn needs a *truthy non-array*: a provider-config `data`, or a `bind` path resolving to an object.

That matters beyond pedantry. Had you built the fixture on the card's stated case, the test would have been green before and after and proved nothing — the exact failure mode this card's own framing invited. Building it on the measured case is why the recompute-count assertion means something.

### The sweep found a worse instance than the named site

`ObjectPivotTable` has no unconditional empty-state early return, so the fresh array **escapes the component** into `PivotTable` as `finalSchema.data`, where it keys the cross-tabulation memo — rebuilding row/column sets, the bucket map and totals on every render over no rows. `ObjectDataTable` at least threw its wasted work away behind `finalData.length === 0`. The card named `ObjectDataTable` as "the only site"; the sweep I asked for is what surfaced the one that leaks further.

### Verified independently, not taken from the body

- **The precedent is exact.** `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx:614` is `const EMPTY_ROWS = Object.freeze([]) as unknown as DataTableSchema['data']`, and `:770` is `const data = Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : EMPTY_ROWS`. You matched that shape byte-for-byte, cast included — so this really is "the same remedy for one defect class", not a second one that merely rhymes.
- **The freeze carries no regression.** I grepped both `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/**` and `packages/components/src/**` for in-place mutation of `finalData` / `schema.data` (`push|pop|shift|unshift|splice|sort|reverse|fill`) — **zero hits**. Freezing a shared instance is only safe if nothing mutates what it is handed, and that is now measured rather than hoped.
- **All three filed findings exist**, unassigned and unlabelled (correct — routing labels are triage's to produce): **#5562** (`PivotTable`'s own two per-render literals, the third site, outside your file surface), **#5564** (the i18n identity churn), **#5565** is the other dev's from this same round. Cross-read against each other for twins: three distinct surfaces, no duplicate filings.

### The tests discriminate the fix from a suppression, which was the requirement

An `eslint-disable` would have cleared the `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warning and left the defect intact, so "the warning is gone" was never going to be evidence. What you assert instead:

- recompute count via `buildFieldMeta` (`afterMount === 2`, unchanged across three host churns; pre-fix 8),
- direct identity on the pivot (`new Set(captured.data).size === 1`) plus `Object.isFrozen`,
- and both suites carry the vacuum guard — *"proves the memo really ran its enrichment branch"*, *"the component really reached `PivotTable`, and with no rows"* — so neither absence assertion can pass by rendering nothing.

The second case in each file ("still re-derives when rows actually arrive", "still forwards rows") is the part that stops this being a freeze-everything fix. Good.

The `I18N_CONFIG` hoist deserves a note: declaring it at module scope because `I18nProvider` memoizes on the config *identity* is the same bug class as the one under test, one level up, in your own test harness. Catching that in the fixture rather than shipping a flaky measurement is the right instinct.

### Status — no enqueue yet

Path surface from `get_files`: 5 files, all `packages/plugin-dashboard/**` plus the changeset. **No governed surface**, so the ordinary ready → merge-queue path applies once the gate jobs read `completed: success` **by name**. CI is still converging; nothing red. I will not enqueue off an aggregate reading.
